titles.title: Wildfire Emissions Prevention Act of 2025
Wildfire Emissions Prevention Act of 2025
A bill to amend the Clean Air Act to modify the handling of air quality monitoring with respect to prescribed fires, and for other purposes.

action.text: Senate Committee on Environment and Public Works. Hearings held prior to introduction and/or referral. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-343.
